events.verdict: LLS shows that when Knox (NYK) extends his arm back at the start of the drive, he makes marginal contact with Morris's (BOS) chest area, not his face.
RAR shows that Morris (BOS) does not make contact with Knox (NYK), who loses the ball on his own accord.
LLB shows that Irving (BOS) comes down across Robinson's (NYK) arms, knocking the ball loose.
RHH shows that Ntilikina (NYK) shuffles his feet when he starts his drive
Hardaway Jr. (NYK) places a hand to Hayward's (BOS) hip, but slides it off without bringing it to a pause.
After the initial screen, Horford (BOS) holds Hardaway Jr.'s (NYK) arm as he rolls down the lane.
Tatum (BOS) runs up to, but not through Ntilikina (NYK), who is retreating along his path and then trips on his own accord.
RATR shows that as Tatum (BOS ) and Hardaway Jr. (NYK) go up for the ball, Tatum brings his arm down over Hardaway Jr.'s shoulder, affecting his ability to get to the jump ball.
Ntilikina (NYK) maintains a legal forearm to Irving (BOS) during his driving shot attempt.
Horford (BOS) places a hand to Ntilikina's (NYK) back, but does not force him into an illegal position on Irving's (BOS) drive.
Vonleh (NYK) establishes a legal screening position in Morris's (BOS) path before the contact.
LHH shows that Morris (BOS) extends his arm in front of Vonleh (NYK) as he turns off the screen and impedes his progress. Vonleh also clamps Morris's arm, but the impede is the first foul.
Vonleh (NYK) establishes a legal screening position in Morris's (BOS) path before the contact.
Vonleh (NYK) clamps Morris's (BOS) arm during the rebound, affecting his ability to get to the ball.
Horford (BOS) extends his arm into Burke (NYK) during the pass and maintains space, but he doesn't dislodge him from his legally obtained position.
Ntilikina (NYK) makes marginal contact to Horford (BOS) after he has gathered the ball and doesn't affect his ability to release the pass.
Horford (BOS) and Vonleh (NYK) engage off ball.
[Observable in enhanced video] Vonleh (NYK) lifts his pivot foot at the start of his dribble.
Morris (BOS) extends somewhat into Vonleh's (NYK) path and then they disengage.
RHH shows Irving (BOS) reaches back as he drives and cups the underside of Vonleh's (NYK) arm during his drive, but doesn't affect his ability to defend the drive.
Vonleh (NYK) blocks the shot by Irving (BOS), which has a chance to score, after it has touched the backboard.
Burke (NYK) makes contact with Horford (BOS) while trying to get to the loose ball.
Brown (BOS) puts a hand on Hardaway Jr.'s (NYK) hip before the ball is placed at the disposal of Ntilikina (NYK) to throw the ball in.
Burke (NYK) and Smart (BOS) engage and disengage before the throw-in.
Vonleh (NYK) has control of the ball before he steps behind the line and calls timeout after five seconds has elapsed.
Tatum (BOS) and Brown (BOS) cleanly dislodge the ball from Hardaway Jr. (NYK). Contact after the ball is dislodged is marginal.
Brown (BOS) is issued a technical foul for contact with Mudiay (NYK) during a dead ball situation. All technical fouls are reviewed by League Operations.
Mudiay (NYK) commits a take foul after Brown (BOS) has gathered the ball during his driving shot attempt.
Smart (BOS) makes contact with Vonleh's (NYK) arm affecting his ability to control the loose ball.
Tatum (BOS) initiates contact with Ntilikina (NYK), who briefly makes hand contact with his back, but does not bring his hand to a pause.
Mudiay (NYK) jumps in front of Irving (BOS) and makes contact with the ball and not Irving's arm/wrist.
Morris (BOS) commits a take foul on Mudiay (NYK).
